dfl.label_source: Provider possession and explicit live/dead flags

skillcorner_a_league.label_source: Provider H/A, with phase-gap D as a weak training proxy, not verified dead-ball truth

skillcorner_legacy.label_source: Provider H/A only; unknown frames stay masked

development.notes: Each development fold holds out one full match. Run records identify the match scored and the matches used for fitting.

spanish_robustness.notes: We score H/A at native timing on labeled frames and report those results separately. These matches are held out from fitting and tuning.

evaluation_notes: The training pool is an inventory. We check the source, usage rights, file checksums and label mapping for the matches a run uses.
All halves, resampled copies and degraded variants retain their match's split. Both test sets are reserved for final evaluation.
Run records identify the matches used, their label sources, the development split and the dataset version. Only the DFL test pair is used for ranking.
Robustness comparisons use the same dropout masks across models. The masks and possession-label views come from external matches.
We use the organizer's public five minutes to check the pipeline. Training and model selection use external matches.
